name: gfx_pipeline
doc: One entry of the render pipeline cache (src/gfx/pipeline.ts). The key is program + vertex layout + blend, depth-stencil and raster state + target formats. Request is the first draw that needs the key: the replayer starts createRenderPipelineAsync and reports Built or Error (gfx_pipeline_done). A draw in Building is still issued: the replayer creates the pipeline synchronously for it. A draw in Failed is skipped.
